description: IDRIS: Integrated Civil Infrastructure and Digital Resilience System is a model or code deposit deposited in Zenodo by its authors Rosemary Makena Gitonga. IDRIS is an open-access decision support system that converts public federal data into a single validated composite resilience score for a geographic unit. Four decoupled layers covering demand pressure, retail capacity, freight friction, and population vulnerability are normalized and combined through a documented weighting matrix, with results stratified into four operational risk bands. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is MIT. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
